590040656.text: You can now copy datapoint and dimension comments by defining rules to copy across date periods like 2025 to 2026 or from one dimension member/version to another. Additionally, you can copy comments with filters for selected dimension members such as a specific product or country. This can be done directly from Comment Management.
590040656.title: Copy Comment Enhancement to Support Filter and Rule

590040657.text: You can now use Joule directly in the Lite Viewer to ask natural language questions, explore automatic insights, and copy charts into the Designer.
590040657.title: Joule Support for Lite Viewer

590040658.text: You can now schedule and publish stories based on SAP SuccessFactors Enterprise Connectivity with support for Broadcast and Burst modes across all formats.
590040658.title: Scheduling Publication (Burst) based on SFSF Enterprise Connectivity

590040659.text: You can now export datapoint and dimension comments as a CSV file directly from the Comment Management preview page. All columns on preview will be exported including the columns added in the filters.
590040659.title: Export Datapoint & Dimension Comments from Comment Management

590040660.text: Add AI Trend Analysis to your metrics report subscription to get a summary of highlights and historical changes in your metrics. The AI-assisted trend analysis feature can generate meaningful insights starting from the 3rd report that is sent.
590040660.title: Add AI Trend Analysis to Your Metrics Report

590040661.text: You can now choose to include all metrics in a list, or only send notifications when metrics meet their thresholds in your metrics report subscription.
590040661.title: More Options to Customize Your Metrics Report Subscription

590040662.text: When creating or editing a metric, you can define a threshold condition to proactively monitor the current status against a set number.
590040662.title: Define Thresholds in My Metrics

590040663.text: Create a new metric directly in My Metrics by selecting a dataset or model. Once you have selected a data source and measure, you can modify the applied filters, add a variance or threshold, and customize the chart visualization.
590040663.title: Create New Metric in My Metrics

590040664.text: You are now offered an improved user interface and user experience for managing and selecting variants in the variable dialog.
590040664.title: Improved User Experience for Managing and Selecting Variants

590040665.text: You can now use Save As in Lite Viewer to save a copy of your story without leaving the Lite Viewer Experience.
590040665.title: Save a Copy of your Story in Lite Viewer

590040666.text: The default theme of SAP Analytics Cloud is set to Morning Horizon (Light) until you customize your appearance settings.
590040666.title: Default Theme in SAP Analytics Cloud

590040667.text: You can now arrange homepage cards in a specific order that remains consistent as your screen gets larger, while automatically adapting to fewer columns on smaller devices. The layout displays up to four columns on larger screens and adjusts responsively as screen size decreases.
590040667.title: Home Page Cards Resizing Order

590040668.text: You can now open My Metrics links in the application's Lite Viewer. To access functionality not supported by the Lite Viewer, select Open My Metrics in Full Viewer.
590040668.title: My Metrics Lite Viewer

590040669.text: Administrators can now schedule start and end dates for custom Home page cards. End users only see cards that are relevant to them, within the scheduled timeframe.
590040669.title: Scheduling Home Page Custom Cards

590040670.text:
The following Language and Region settings have been updated:
- The Display Language and Data Access Language settings now display supported languages in a two-column list, allowing you to view the source and target languages side-by-side. In addition, you can choose to set the browser language as your display language.
- The Date Format and Time Format settings now display formatting options in a two-column list, including live preview examples so you can see how your dates and times will appear.
590040670.title: Enhanced User Settings

590040671.text: The old Home screen has been fully deprecated from SAP Analytics Cloud. Check out the newly designed home screen.
590040671.title: The Old Home Screen Deprecation

590040672.text:
You can now edit metrics after they have been added to My Metrics. You can modify the filters applied to the metric chart, as well as the variance. In the chart visualization details step, you can change the chart type, members selection, and color. In addition, multiple users can simultaneously edit the same metric. When the metric is shared, everyone with access to it is notified of the update.
Once a metric is saved, you cannot undo your edits. Note that if a metric is included in a subscription and the context of the metric value is edited, previously recorded values are cleared from the metrics report.
590040672.title: My Metrics: Edit Metrics Created from Story Chart

590040673.text: Use the Tracing Session in the Support Agent tool to capture errors you encounter and to record key information while using SAP Analytics Cloud. Recorded data remains on your tenant but SAP Support can analyze it for troubleshooting. Only SAP Support can see this data.
590040673.title: Tracing Session

590040674.text: The SAP Analytics Cloud Blog home screen card displays the 10 most recent SAP Community blog posts. You can pin up to 3 posts at a time.
590040674.title: SAP Analytics Cloud Blog Home Screen Card

590040675.text: When you subscribe to a metrics report, you now have the option to send emails to a Microsoft Teams channel in the Distribution List step.
590040675.title: Send Emails to Microsoft Teams Channel When You Subscribe to Metrics Report

590040676.text:
The Favorites and Recent views save time by eliminating the need to browse from the root level of the file repository each time content is opened or saved. You can now use these views in the following locations:
- Files repository: Select the Recent view to see a list of files that you recently accessed (created, edited, or opened).
- Open dialogs: When working with a story, data action, multi action, calendar task, and other workflows, select the Favorites or Recent views. You can quickly access content of a specific resource type that you marked as a favorite or recently accessed (created, edited, or opened).For example, you add a chart to a story and select a model or dataset. The Favorites view shows only dataset and model files that you marked as a favorite. The Recent view shows only dataset and model files that you recently accessed. Other resource types that you marked as favorite or recently accessed don't appear in the lists.
- Save dialogs: When saving a file, select the Favorites or Recent views. The Favorites view shows folder locations that you marked as a favorite. The Recent view shows folder locations where you recently accessed (created, edited, or opened) content that matches the resource type you're saving. Review the following examples for the Recent view.
- You recently access a story in My Files/Public/Folder 1. When you create a story and save it, the Recent view shows Folder 1 because you recently opened a file of the same type (a story) in Folder 1.
- You recently access a story in root of My Files (or a workspace), for example My Files/StoryFileA. When you create a story and save it, this location won't appear in the Recent view because it is already available in the dialog.
- You recently access a story in a subfolder of My Files (or a workspace), for example My Files/SubfolderA/StoryFileA. When you create a story and save it, this location will appear in the Recent view.
590040676.title: Favorite and Recent Views Available in Open and Save Dialogs

590040677.text: Subscribe to metrics report and receive scheduled in-app and email notifications of changes in your metrics list. You can set the start date and time of the first occurrence, define the recurrence pattern, and add recipients of the metrics report.
590040677.title: Subscribe to Metrics Report

590040678.text:
Customers using BW comment will now have the flexibility to provide the below combination of BW live comment privileges:
• Read comment only
• Read and create comments
• Read, create and delete comments
590040678.title: BW Live Authorization with READ_CREATE_CHANGE

590040679.text:
You can now schedule Stories based on a Datasphere live connection.
Prerequisites:
• Have Datasphere and SAP Analytics cloud in the Unified Customer Landscape (UCL) formation
• Create a Datasphere Tunnel connection in SAP Analytics cloud
Schedule your story based on the on the Datasphere Tunnel connection instead of a direct connection
590040679.title: Scheduling Stories based on Datasphere Live Connections

590040680.text:
The new Horizon theme has been released in SAP Analytics Cloud. You can select from one of these Horizon themes:
- SAP Morning Horizon (Light)
- SAP Morning Horizon (Dark)
- SAP Horizon High Contrast White
- SAP Horizon High Contrast Black
590040680.title: Horizon Release in SAP Analytics Cloud

590040681.text:
Check out the enhanced user settings. Your profile and user preference settings are now organized in one dialog to make it easier for you to manage and save the following settings:
- User Account: Edit your profile and password.
- Appearance: Personalize your theme to accommodate your accessibility needs.
- Home Screen: Customize your home screen cards and set a default tab.
- Languages and Region: Adjust your user preferences.
- Application: Set your default application.
- Notifications: Adjust your email and in-app notification settings.
590040681.title: User Settings Enhancements

590040682.text: The updated search now provides improved autocomplete capabilities and accurately lists top suggestions based on your search criteria. As you type a key term, the search scans across SAP Analytics Cloud, offering a broader and more flexible scope to deliver the best matching results. You can quickly find your files, folders, and objects.
590040682.title: Shell Bar Search Enhancements

590040683.text: Explore the enhanced side navigation featuring a reorganized tool layout and improved interaction for expanding navigation groups. The new Utilities section, includes the workspace management, content network, translation, transfer, connections, and performance tools. The About is now accessible in your profile settings and includes information about your landscape type. Other changes include the implementation of a sticky footer and improved scroll bar.
590040683.title: Side Navigation Enhancements

590040684.text: The header sender address for default SMTP server will no longer be available starting 2026. If you still want to use header sender address, you can switch to custom SMTP server.
590040684.title: Deprecating Header Sender Address for Default SMTP Server

590040685.text: You can now select Users and Teams using the new member select while creating and editing your schedule.
590040685.title: Adopt Common Controls Member Selector for adding Users and Teams in Schedule Publication Create and Edit Dialogs

590040686.text: My Metrics is a new module that helps you organize your own list of KPIs and shared metrics. By adding data points from your story, you can easily monitor and analyze changes in your data.
590040686.title: Introducing My Metrics in SAP Analytics Cloud

590040687.text: Introducing My Metrics home card. You can now select one of your lists to appear on your home screen.
590040687.title: My Metrics Home Card

590040688.text: The home cards can now be horizontally or vertically resized when you select the bottom-right corner and drag it to the desired size.
590040688.title: Resize Home Card

590040689.text:
The user interface can now be translated into the following languages:
- Kazakh (kk-KZ)
- Macedonian (mk-MK)
- Montenegrin (sr-ME)
- Serbian Cyrillic (sr-Cyrl-RS)
590040689.title: Supported User Interface Languages

590040690.text: The SAP Analytics Cloud home screen has been redesigned with enhanced customization options and new cards.
590040690.title: Redesigned SAP Analytics Cloud Home Screen

590040691.text: Starting from a story in view mode, you can now create an (data analyzer) insight and pin it to the story visualization for personal quick access. For this, simply open data analyzer from the standard context menu Open Data Analyzer in your story visualization, explore the data in data analyzer and save and pin the insight to the story visualization. You can repeat this procedure according to your business needs; there is no limitation on the number of pinned insights to a story visualization. The pinned insights are listed in an ascending order from newest to oldest under the Open Data Analyzer context menu entry.
590040691.title: Ability to Save and Pin Data Analyzer Insights to Story in View Mode

590040692.text:
The following report-report (RRI) jump target types are now supported in view mode:
- ABAP Report
- Web Dynpro
- Custom created report types
- Classic BAdls (Business Add-Ins)
- Dynamic BAdls (Business Add-Ins)
You can now jump to RRI targets from the following table cell types in view mode:
- Header cells
- Dimension column cells
- Dimension row cells
- Total cells
590040692.title: Report-Report Interface Support in View Mode

590040693.text:
The report-report interface (RRI) support in SAP Analytics Cloud has been enhanced:
- support of custom created jump targets (static/classic BAdI (Business Add-In) and dynamic BAdI) so that users can perform specific operations when analyzing data in SAP Analytics Cloud
- full support of RRI functionality for SAP Analytics Cloud models created with a live data connection to an SAP S4/HANA system
590040693.title: Enhanced Support for Report-Report Interface

590040694.text: You can now choose if you want the datetime values returned from the database displayed without any time zone shift (default), or if you want to treat the values as UTC and shift them into your browser local time zone.
590040694.title: Ability to Choose Datetime Values Returned from the Database

590040695.text:
In the Lite Viewer, you can now create or edit story filters in view mode when working with the following filter types:
- Filter by Member
- Filter by Condition
Note
You can only edit filters for which you have delete authorization.
590040695.title: Editing Filters in Lite Viewer

590040696.text: In the new table build experience, you can now use the context menu options Move Up and Move Down to move a dimension one position up or down in the list of dimensions in the Rows or Columns section of the Builder panel and the Quick Builder panel. The new context menu options are also available for measure members in the Measures structure feed when you use an SAP BW live data connection.
590040696.title: Context Menu Options for Reordering Dimensions and SAP BW Measure Structure Members (New Table Build Experience)

590040697.text:
In the new table build experience, you can now reorder members (measures and calculations) within the Measures structure feed in the Builder panel and in the Quick Builder panel using drag and drop. This applies to tables connected to live SAP BW data.
Any reordering you perform is immediately reflected in the table widget. You can also drag members from the Data panel and drop them into any valid position within the structure feed.
590040697.title: Drag-and-Drop Reordering of SAP BW Measure Structure Members in Tables (New Table Build Experience)

590040698.text: You can now run an object size analysis on your stories. The Story Object Size panel, lists all objects in the story along with their size and the percentage of the story size each object contributes to. This can help you identify objects that need optimizing for faster story loading.
590040698.title: Story Object Size Analysis

590040699.text: You can now sync the axis for each measure in Combination of Column and Line charts.
590040699.title: Chart Axis Sync

590040700.text: You can now customize the title of each axis in your charts.
590040700.title: Chart Axis Customization

590040702.text:
In the new table build experience, as a story designer, you can now configure the maximum number of rows and columns displayed in a table. In story Edit mode, open the Builder panel and go to Table Properties to choose from three result limit types:
- Default: 500 rows × 60 columns
- Custom: Define your own limits.
- Unlimited: All data loaded, not recommended for large datasets.
If the server returns more data than the specified limit, a warning appears in the table subtitle. As before, both story designers and story viewers can edit the result limit directly from that warning, without leaving the current mode.
590040702.title: Result Limit Configuration for Tables (New Table Build Experience)

590040703.text: In the new table build experience, as a story designer, you can now merge consecutive header cells that share the same member name in your table. When an outer dimension repeats the same value across multiple rows or columns, you can activate the new display option Merge Cells with Repeated Member Names from the dimension's context menu in the table or in the builder panel. The cells are visually combined into a single spanned cell, eliminating repetition and making data groupings easier to read.
590040703.title: Merge Table Cells with Repeated Member Names (New Table Build Experience)

590040704.text: Single selection hierarchy is now supported for story and page filters. When you use single selection hierarchy, there are two options. You can select a node and its descendants, or you can also limit the leaf node selection, so that no nodes except the lowest level can be selected.
590040704.title: Single Selection Hierarchy Support

590040705.text:
In the new table build experience, you can now filter dimensions based on conditions or by selecting single members. In story edit and in story view mode, new context menu options are available from dimension headers in your table widget:
- Filter Options   Filter by Member...
- Filter Options   Filter by Condition...
In story edit mode, these options are also available in the Rows and Columns section of the builder panel when you select the filter icon in the object's token. When you add a filter in the Filters section of the builder panel, you can launch the required filter dialog by selecting the object with the corresponding suffix: (Member) or (Condition).
590040705.title: Filter Tables from Headers (New Table Build Experience)

590040706.text:
In the new table build experience, you can now use conditions to filter dimensions. As a story designer, you can launch the filter dialog to set conditions in the following ways:
- Add the required dimension with the suffix (Condition) to the Filters section in the builder panel.
- Select Filter By Condition... from the filter icon in the dimension's token in the Rows and Columns section of the builder panel.
- Select a new context menu option from the dimension header in the table widget: Filter Options   Filter by Condition....
As a story viewer, you can use the new context menu option Filter Options   Filter by Condition... from the dimension header in your table.
590040706.title: Conditions in Table Filters (New Table Build Experience)

590040707.text:
In the new table build experience, table titles of newly added tables now display the dimensions and measures (or accounts) you use in the table instead of the model name. The title automatically updates when you change the dimensions and measures (or accounts) on the table axes. When you edit the title manually, it becomes fixed and no longer updates automatically unless you delete the entire title.
Tip
To apply auto-generated titles to your existing tables, delete the current title.
590040707.title: Table Titles (New Table Build Experience)

590040708.text: In the new table build experience, as a story designer, you can now turn Date Clarification on or off in the Display Options of time and date dimensions. When you turn this setting on, the system adds additional date details (year or quarter) in parentheses next to date descriptions in your table.
590040708.title: Date Clarification for Time and Date Dimensions (New Table Build Experience)

590040709.text: When in the full viewer,  you can now edit story filters in view mode.
590040709.title: Editing Filters in View Mode

590040710.text:
The classic story experience and analytic applications are now deprecated.
For more information on features that are no longer supported, see [Important Notice: Changes in SAP Analytics Cloud Classic Stories and Analytic Applications](https://community.sap.com/t5/technology-blog-posts-by-sap/important-notice-changes-in-sap-analytics-cloud-classic-stories-amp/ba-p/13705220)
590040710.title: Classic Story Experience and Analytic Applications: Deprecation Notice

590040711.text: Composite designers are now able to add and manage input controls in composites.
590040711.title: Input Control Support in Composites

590040712.text: You can now copy and paste composites within a story, across pages, across different stories, and even across browser tabs.
590040712.title: Copy and Paste Composite Support

590040713.text: You can now preview all comments associated with a model or version directly from the Comment Management Dashboard. You can filter, sort, and search through datapoint and dimension comments by various columns such as owner, version, measure, and date.
590040713.title: Preview Comments on Comment Management Dashboard at Model and Version Level

590040714.text: Schedule Publication owners can now add co-owners to help manage schedules. Co-owners with the required schedule privileges can update details, recipients, file settings, prompts, filters, and distribution settings. They can also delete or cancel schedules.
590040714.title: Addition of Co-owners to Manage Schedules

590040715.text: You can now delete selected comments from the preview page on the Comment Management dashboard. When previewing comments, you can view and filter comments. You can then select all comments or choose specific comments to delete.
590040715.title: Delete Selected Comments from the Comment Management Dashboard

590040716.text: In the new table build experience, you can now drag and drop objects from the data panel to your table widget when it is of type Cross-tab. Blended tables are also supported.
590040716.title: Drag and Drop Objects from Data Panel to Table Widget (New Table Build Experience)

590040717.text: The filter search dialog has been modified to make it easier to quickly update your member selections. There are now buttons to Set and Update the search selection. Set replaces the existing member selection with the new members you have selected. Update adds the new selections to the existing member list.
590040717.title: Filter Search Update

590040718.text: In the new table build experience, tables load only a limited subset of table rows initially and fetch more data on demand. Now, this data fetching strategy also applies to columns. As you scroll down or to the right, the system automatically loads both rows and columns.
590040718.title: Lazy Loading for Table Columns (New Table Build Experience)

590040719.text: Stories now have an additional set of ready-to-use custom charts which provide new ways to visualize data without any coding. These charts are pre-built and you can add them directly to your story or request access if they aren't already available. Custom charts will be available only for SAC tenants that are part of BDC formation. SAC Enterprise tenants will not be able to access this feature.
590040719.title: New Custom Charts added to Stories

590040720.text: You can now add custom devices in responsive pages and configure responsive layouts for iOS and Android device types.
590040720.title: Custom Device Support for iOS and Android Device Types in Responsive Pages

590040721.text: In the new table build experience, you can now view the version dimension filter in the table's main context menu under Applied to Table. From this context menu, you can edit or delete the filter, apply sorting, or change the version dimension display options.The version dimension filter is now included in the filter count and appears in the table subtitle.
590040721.title: Version Dimension Filter in Main Context Menu and Table Subtitle (New Table Build Experience)

590040722.text:
In the custom widget builder panel, you can now set a custom date when you're editing a range filter.
Account-Based filters are now supported by custom widgets.
590040722.title: Custom Widgets Support Custom Dates and Account-Based Filters

590040723.text: The default local theme has been updated to SAP Morning Horizon, and it will be applied to all new stories. If a story uses a theme that is deleted, the theme will fall back to SAP Morning Horizon.
590040723.title: New Local Theme

590040724.text: You can now enable quick builder for charts to quickly change which dimensions and measures are displayed. To use the quick builder, select a supported chart and select Enable Quick Builder in the View Mode section of the builder panel. This will add the Open Quick Builder menu option to the main context menu of the chart in view mode.
590040724.title: Enable Quick Builder for Charts

590040725.text:
When you export data from a table as an Excel file and Include Formatting is selected, you now have additional options for formatting your cells. You can select Format as General to format exported cells as text, or select Format as True Value Type to keep Excel cell formatting.
Selecting Format as True Value Type ensures that exported cells retain Excel formatting, such as Currency, Unit, Percentage, Scale formats (Thousand (k), Million (m), and Billion (bn)), Date, Time, as well as decimal places and separators.
590040725.title: Retain Table Export Formatting

590040726.text: With the availability of the new table build experience, we’re starting to phase out the previous table build experience. To benefit from new features, we recommend that you switch to the new table build experience. In the future, the previous table build experience will no longer be available.
590040726.title: Previous Table Build Experience: Deprecation Notice

590040727.text: You can now add gauge, funnel, and sankey charts to your stories. Gauge charts are used to display the performance of a single key measure or KPI. Funnel charts are useful for visualizing the progressive reduction of data as it passes through sequential stages in a process. Sankey charts show how quantities move from one point to another.
590040727.title: Add New Chart Types

590040728.text: You can now enable Show Totals in both blended charts and blended tables.
590040728.title: Blended Data Show Totals

590040729.text:
In the new table build experience, you can now configure data visibility.
To build an asymmetric table, use visibility filters on each member of a structure (Account, Measures, or Structure / Cross Calculations) to define which levels of the inner hierarchies are visible. You can also control whether Totals appears. As you apply filters to each structure member, the axis becomes asymmetric.
You can also apply visibility filters to any hierarchical dimension (except Account) assigned to the table. In this case, the data remains symmetric: When you hide a hierarchy level or Totals, the change applies to all member combinations (entire rows or columns).
590040729.title: Data Visibility in Tables (New Table Build Experience)

590040730.text: When you open an optimized story with tables in edit mode, the system now prompts you to switch to the new table build experience. When you switch, your story is loaded and saved in the new experience. In addition, the system creates a story version using the previous table build experience, which you can use as backup file version.
590040730.title: Prompt to Switch to New Table Build Experience

590040731.text: The new data panel replaces the available objects panel. It combines the available objects panel functionality with the story toolbar's Add New Data functionality to create one central place where users can manage models in a story, search for data across all models, and view all the available data objects for a particular model. A number of ease of use enhancements have also been made, such as the ability to update a widget data source, to open a model in the Modeler, or to use a model to start a Data Analyzer Insight.
590040731.title: Use the new Data Panel

590040732.text:
In the new table build experience, tables with more than one dimension in the rows that display totals below the dimension value cells and parent nodes below their descendants now display each member of the outer dimension at the top, aligned with the first row of the inner dimension group. For dimensions in the columns, the outer dimension members are now displayed on the left, aligned with the first column of the inner dimension group. Note
If you have defined styling options for outer dimension members, these styling options might not be applied. To resolve this, you need to redefine the styling options. Alternatively, you can resolve the issue at short notice by going to the builder panel and activating the following setting in the Properties section: Classic Display of Outer Dimension Members. Note that this setting is only available temporarily. In the long term, you need to redefine the styling options for the outer dimension members.
590040732.title: Position of Outer Dimension Members with Totals and Parent Nodes Below (New Table Build Experience)

590040733.text: In the optimized design experience, new Range Type options are available in the dynamic date and time range filter: Rest of and Rest of (with offset). For example, you can create a filter based on the Rest of Year starting with the current date and ending on December 31.
590040733.title: Use New Range Type Options in the Dynamic Date and Time Range Filter

590040734.text: In the optimized design experience you can now drag and drop from the Available Objects panel to build charts.
590040734.title: Drag and Drop Available Objects to Build Charts

590040735.text: You can now use the regional number formats lakh and crore to format charts, geo maps, and tables (new table build experience only).
590040735.title: Use Regional Number Formats

590040736.text: A new setDataPointCommentPaused() API has been introduced to reduce the number of comment requests sent to the comments service when adding or deleting comments. Story developers can add this new API in their scripts to optimize comments performance when adding or deleting comments via script APIs.
590040736.title: Optimize Comments Performance in Scripts with <samp class="ph codeph">setDataPointCommentPaused()</samp>

590040737.text: As a story developer, you can now write scripts for the onBeforeImport event for the Data Upload Starter. This event allows you to validate and edit the Excel or CSV data uploaded to the Data Upload Starter before proceeding with the data upload. This validation step helps you ensure that the data uploaded is in the correct format.
590040737.title: Data Upload Starter <samp class="ph codeph">onBeforeImport</samp> Event

590040738.text: With the re-designed numeric point chart in optimized stories, it is now possible to configure the secondary binding to use the inline look and feel.
590040738.title: Configure Secondary Bindings in Numeric Point Charts

590040739.text: Pareto charts can now be added to your stories.
590040739.title: Pareto Charts

590040740.text: A new data preview dialog allows story designers to quickly review data they are about to upload to a story before creating an embedded dataset with local files. This preview helps visualizing both the raw data from the file, but also the dimensions and measures the application will create. It is also possible to perform data preparation tasks before committing the data to the story.This preview also streamlines the data upload process by eliminating unnecessary steps and reducing potential errors. User can now easily abandon incorrect uploads or proceed directly to the story canvas without entering the full dataset editing screen.
590040740.title: Data Preview for Embedded Datasets

590040741.text: When you create a new story and add a table widget, you automatically work in the new table build experience. The same applies when you convert a classic story with tables to the optimized story experience.
590040741.title: New Table Build Experience Used in New Stories

590040742.text: In the new table build experience, you can now apply existing custom orders for dimensions on blended tables, unless they are based on SAP BW models.
590040742.title: Dimension Custom Orders in Blended Tables (New Table Build Experience)

590040743.text: In the new table build experience, you can now use ↑ / ↓ arrows to format positive and negative values in tables. This option is available for all data models in the Show Sign As dropdown for calculations and measures.
590040743.title: Show Sign As Arrows (↑ / ↓) for Numeric Formatting (New Table Build Experience)

590040744.text:
In the new table build experience, you can now allow the usage of a simplified builder panel in story view mode (previously known as Navigation Panel) by selecting Enable Quick Builder in the View Mode section of the builder panel. This adds the Open Quick Builder menu entry to the main context menu of the table.
When you are in view mode, the quick builder panel can also accessed using the scripts: openQuickBuilder() and closeQuickBuilder().
590040744.title: Enable Quick Builder (New Table Build Experience)

590040745.text: In the new table build experience (edit mode) and in the quick builder (view mode), for SAP BW queries only, you can now enable a compact display of the dimensions in the rows or columns. As a result, all dimensions of the respective axis are displayed hierarchically in your table.
590040745.title: Compact Display (New Table Build Experience)

590040746.text: In the new table build experience, you can now use pagination. If your table is on a canvas page, you can use the option Auto-Size And Page Table Vertically in the Reporting section of the builder panel.
590040746.title: Pagination (New Table Build Experience)

590040747.text: You can now carry bar chart patterns and colors from a composite into your stories.
590040747.title: Stories Support Custom Patterns and Colors Work for Composite Charts

590040748.text: Privileges for data point commenting have been reworked and a new Change privilege has been introduced for BW comments. This new privilege grant users the possibility to read, create and change BW comments, but not delete them. This provides more flexibility for privilege assignments.
590040748.title: New Data Point Commenting Privilege

590040749.text: In the new table build experience, you can now use non-aggregated list tables. The table improvements in view mode are also now available for non-aggregated list tables.
590040749.title: Non-Aggregated List Tables (New Table Build Experience)

590040750.text: With the file versions feature, you can save different versions of your stories (optimized design experience). For each version, you’ll know who saved it and when. Also, you’ll be able to open any version in read-only mode. If you need to revert to an earlier version, you can easily select and restore it, making it the most current version for editing.
590040750.title: Create File Versions for Stories

590040751.text: Area charts are now available for stories that use the optimized experience.
590040751.title: Create Area Charts

590040752.text: In the new table build experience, you can now set filter members to invisible.
590040752.title: Invisible Filter Members (New Table Build Experience)

590040753.text: In the Builder panel of the new table build experience, the planning-related settings have been moved from the Properties section into a separate Planning section.
590040753.title: Builder Panel Layout (New Table Build Experience)

fields.Area: Data Acquisition, Live Data Connections, and Integration

590040754.text: Live data access now supports SharePoint as a data source. Modelers will now be able to consume Excel sheets and Lists files hosted on SharePoint to create models in SAP Analytics Cloud.
590040754.title: SharePoint Support for Live Data Access

fields.Area: Data Acquisition, Live Data Connections, and Integration

590040755.text: Live direct access now supports Databricks as a data source. You can now create live connections to Databricks, and modelers can now add live versions based on data stored in Databricks workspaces.
590040755.title: Databricks Support For Live Direct Access

fields.Area: Data Acquisition, Live Data Connections, and Integration

590040756.text:
You can now connect to SAP HANA Cloud databases, in addition to existing on-premise SAP HANA databases. Connections to SAP HANA Cloud are secured via the JDBC driver with TLS certificate validation.This improvement allows for a simpler configuration compared to on-premise SAP HANA connections with no need for setting up the on-premise SAP Analytics Cloud Agent or Cloud Connector.
Both connection types offer the same capabilities. Overall, this enhancement offers reduced latency and better performance.
590040756.title: Support for Import Connections to SAP HANA Cloud

fields.Area: Data Acquisition, Live Data Connections, and Integration

590040757.text: Live direct access now supports Snowflake as a data source. You can now create live connections to Snowflake with a service user, and modelers can now add live versions based on data stored in Snowflake databases.
590040757.title: Snowflake Support For Live Direct Access

590040758.text: A new option in the Actions menu in the modeler now allows modelers to navigate from a public dimension straight to the job monitor. This enhancement allows modelers to check the status of jobs reusing any given public dimension.
590040758.title: Navigate to Job Monitor from Public Dimension

590040759.text: In the modeler, a new Excel Add-In option in the Actions menu now allows SAP Analytics Cloud, add-in for Microsoft Excel users to open models in Microsoft Excel straight from the modeler. A preconfigured Excel workbook embedding the exported model will be generated automatically.
590040759.title: Navigate to Excel Add-In

590040760.text: Modelers can now expose version dimensions of seamless planning models in SAP Datasphere data builder. This enhancement allows modelers to reuse version dimension information in SAP Datasphere objects, and strengthens the integration of planning data for better analysis and insights.
590040760.title: Expose Version Dimension in Seamless Planning Models

590040761.text: Modelers and planners can now create calculations that display values when filtering on version dimensions, so that they can plan on versions.
590040761.title: Apply Version Selection to Calculations

590040762.text: You can now monitor the status of Data Import API jobs within the job monitor. This enhancement provides better visibility to customers on the status of their import jobs through a central user interface and compliments the monitoring capability of Data Export API and delta calculation jobs.
590040762.title: Monitor Data Import API jobs in Job Monitor

590040763.text: Importing data to public dimensions has been reworked and redesigned with user experience improvements that provide better scalability and usability. Along with these enhancements, it is now also possible to edit existing import jobs rather than recreate them from scratch in case of configuration issues in the import job or changes in the data source.
590040763.title: Import Data to Public Dimension Improvements

590040764.text: Planners and modelers can now reuse SAP Datasphere currency rate tables in SAP Analytics Cloud seamless planning models and no longer need to recreate or replicate the same currency information in multiple tables between both applications. This enhancement will help planners and modelers streamline their currency conversion workflows in SAP Analytics Cloud.
590040764.title: Reuse SAP Datasphere currency rate tables in SAP Analytics Cloud

590040765.text: You can now navigate to the job monitor directly from a model via the Actions  menu in the shell bar, and access and all API import and export jobs related that model.
590040765.title: Navigate from Model to Job Monitor

590040766.text:
When creating dimensions in the modeler, you can now save public dimension tables in the folder of your choice in the Files repository. This gives organizations greater control over public dimension tables — with a structured approach to storage, permissions, and administrative ownership.
The public dimension tables that once have been saved in the classic manner are migrated automatically to the Dimension Tables folder of the Files repository.
590040766.title: Save Dimension Tables in Files Repository

590040767.text:
Adding data to stories has been simplified thanks to a streamlined, unified data selection user experience.
The data selection dialog within stories had been reworked to match the Horizon theme.
The data source selection dialog has also been overhauled, providing the ability to filter and search for specific data sources. By default, the application only displays data sources that have been already configured on the system and for whose you can create connections, as well as the number of preconfigured connections already available per data source.
You can access dialog when adding data to a story, either from the Add New Data option in the toolbar, or via the Data Panel.
590040767.title: Unified Data Selection Dialog

590040768.text: Exporting model data to SAP S/4HANA is now deprecated as of Q2 2026. We recommend using the write back integration scenario to export model data to SAP S/4HANA. For more information, see SAP Note [3707288](https://me.sap.com/notes/3707288), [Exporting Data from SAP Analytics Cloud to SAP S/4HANA Cloud](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_CLOUD/1cbcff7ccd35405ab445b223c1ab1588/15447e5bda934be28f3b16cfb456fb23.html?locale=en-US) for S/4HANA Public Cloud and [Exporting Data from SAP Analytics Cloud to SAP S/4HANA](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_S4HANA_ON-PREMISE/48f4b4785b8e45938ac44a67be8032d9/15447e5bda934be28f3b16cfb456fb23.html) for S/4HANA Private Cloud.
590040768.title: Export Model Data to SAP S/4HANA

590040769.text:
The AVERAGE and COUNT exception aggregations for standard models and public dimensions have been renamed to AVERAGE incl. 0, NULL and COUNT incl. 0, NULL. Before this change, NULL and zero values were included with AVERAGE and COUNT, but this wasn't reflected in the user interface.
This change provides better visibility on what data is included with these aggregation functions and helps to prevent misinterpretation of results.
Additionally, the restriction that prevented base accounts from using Count and Average exception aggregation types has been lifted. It is now possible to apply these exceptions aggregations on account members without requiring a formula.
590040769.title: Exception Aggregations Enhancement

590040770.text: A new Data Export API tab has been introduced in the job monitor where you can now check the status of your data extraction and delta calculation jobs. This addition provides enhanced visibility of your API jobs that use the Data Export Service.
590040770.title: Monitor Delta Extraction and Delta Calculation Jobs

590040771.text: The Details() formula has been deprecated in multiple phases. In phase 3, the Calculated On column has been removed for new and existing models, from both the model account dimension grid and public dimension grid. Additionally, it is no longer possible to select ALL members on an exception aggregation.
590040771.title: Details() Formulas Deprecation

590040772.text: The member selector dialog is now available for base measures, calculated measures, conversion measures, account members and public dimensions of type unit. With this enhancement, modelers can now reference unit types listed within the standard unit table without leaving their model.
590040772.title: Unit Property Improvements

590040773.text: The Data Import Service API now lets you import master data into public dimensions stored in SAP Datasphere.
590040773.title: Data Import Service API Enhancement

590040774.text: The Data Import Service API now lets you import external fact data, coming from data sources other than SAP Analytics Cloud and SAP Datasphere, to an existing private version of a seamless planning model.
590040774.title: Data Import Service API Enhancement

590040775.text: As a user of the modeler, you can now replace local and public dimensions by other public SAP Analytics Cloud dimensions of the same type to adjust the model to a better suiting dimension. Besides, you can now also add an existing public dimension to a cube dimension and thus reuse public SAP Analytics Cloud dimensions.
590040775.title: Replace SAP Analytics Cloud Dimensions with Other Dimensions from SAP Analytics Cloud

590040776.text: When adding a new dimension to a model (in the modeler) that is based on an existing public dimension you can now provide a unique model dimension name which can differ from the public dimension name. This allows you to reuse the public dimension multiple times within the model.
590040776.title: Reuse Public Dimensions

590040777.text: Planners can now paste values copied from external applications such as Excel with the scale of the target cell in an SAP Analytics Cloud table.
590040777.title: Paste with Target Cell Scale

590040778.text:
Planners can now add multiple new lines in tables in one go thanks to a new Add Member Combinations option.
This simplifies data entry, and improves scenarios that require copying/pasting data from external data sources.
590040778.title: Add Multiple Lines in Tables

590040779.text:
A new Repost Member option now allows planners to repost data to unbooked target member combinations in tables by changing dimension values on booked member combinations.
This feature speeds up copy paste operations and is a shortcut for the three-step manual workaround that requires planners to add a new line, copy and paste data values, and delete the unused line and source data.
Additionally, built-in data access control, data locking and planning rules processes guarantee both data compliance and consistency when reposting data.
590040779.title: Repost Data in Tables

590040780.text: You can now create data validation rules to validate your data, instead of having to manually validate data. Create data validation steps in data action using the data validation rules. Review the results of a data action with data validation steps in Job Monitor.
590040780.title: Data Validation Steps in Data Action

590040781.text: If publishing a data action results in an error because of invalid facts, or rather, a validation rule, the Job Monitor now displays the invalid facts.
590040781.title: Invalid Facts Displayed in Job Monitor

590040782.text: You can now automatically add a data filter parameter to all new steps of a data action, instead of having to manually add the parameter each time. When you create the data filter parameter in a data action, select Use parameter in all new data action steps.
590040782.title: Add Data Filter Parameter to New Steps

590040783.text: As a story developer, you can assign story filters and input controls to member type, number type, and data filter type parameters of multi action script objects. You can use the bindInputControl and the getBoundInputControl APIs for multi action script objects, which take effect on member and number type parameters specifically.
590040783.title: Assign Story Filters and Input Controls to Member Type and Data Filter Type Parameters of Multi Action Script Objects

590040784.text:
The default time interval for fluid data entry batches is now set to 50 milliseconds.
This enhancement improves system responsiveness in fluid data entry mode for single cell changes. Data processing now happens immediately after you make a data change, compared to the 1 second turn around time required before. Overall, this enhancement provides a smoother data entry experience for planners.
Note that this change doesn't impact your current time interval configuration.
590040784.title: Improved Fluid Data Entry Response Time

590040785.text: The new Ask before closing a tab if data isn't published setting prevents you from closing the browser tab when you haven't published changes you made. You can find the setting in Edit mode, under Story Settings  View Time Settings  Global Settings  Planning Settings. (This setting only applies in view mode. In edit mode, you won't be asked before closing the tab and your data won't be published.)
590040785.title: New "Ask before closing a tab if data isn't published" Setting

590040786.text: When running multi actions through the multi actions starter, you can now choose to skip non-essential validation checks, reducing execution time. The system validates only multi action privileges and mandatory fields. This option is recommended for only trusted, time-sensitive executions. This option is disabled by default to preserve existing behavior.
590040786.title: Option to Skip Non-Essential Validation in Multi Actions Starter

590040787.text: When you Import Master Data in a multi action import step, you can now select the public dimension directly. You don't have to select a model first any more.
590040787.title: Select Public Dimension directly when importing master data

590040788.text: We've made enhancements to the Validation Rules  Table Preview. If data entry is allowed for some members and blocked for others in a dimension member combination, the status of the parent node is now shown. The status can be Allowed or Blocked. Previously, the parent node of dimension member combinations was crossed out with a diagonal line. Calculated cells now show their data entry availability with a status of either Allowed or Blocked. Previously, the cell only said "Not Supported for Calculated Cell."
590040788.title: Data Entry for Table Preview in Validation Rules

590040789.text: You can now add a new parameter type, the data filter parameter, to steps in data actions and multi actions. By using this parameter setting, you can pass multiple story filters and input control selections through a single parameter to data action steps directly, or to those within a multi action. Additionally, data filter parameters support the use of filters conditions that previously were not supported, including dynamic time filters, exclude filters, and attribute-based filters.
590040789.title: Data Filter Parameter

590040790.text: You can now use data filter parameters in script steps of advanced formulas. Script steps enable you to reuse filters from your story such as member filters, exclude-selected-member filters, condition filters, time filters, and advanced filters without having to recreate them in each formula.
590040790.title: Data Filter Parameter in Script Steps

590040791.text: Add a filter that automatically determines changes made to a public edit or a private version. The dimensions of the changed members are then passed to the data filter parameter, which you can use in a data action step.
590040791.title: Version Changes Filter for Data Filter Parameter

590040792.text: Validation rule configuration has been enhanced to offer more control over unassigned (#) node combinations. It is now possible to explicitly define specific valid combinations for unassigned nodes independently of other member definitions, including support for All Members placeholders, providing greater flexibility in data validation scenarios. This enhanced configuration now allows to define up to six million valid member combinations per validation rule.
590040792.title: Enhanced Validation Rule Configuration

590040793.text: When working in a story, you can now track and manage data actions and multi actions in the job monitor panel, without having to leave the story. In the story toolbar, select  (Monitor Panel). An embedded job monitor panel opens, displaying the status of data actions and multi actions. The job categories aren't available by tab but you can filter for them. Select  (Show Filters) and choose the corresponding filter. To jump to the job monitor, select Open in Job Monitor Module.
590040793.title: Embedded Job Monitor

590040794.text: You can now add a comment management step to a multi action to copy or delete comments across versions of a model. Use the Copy action to transfer data point or dimension comments from a source version to a target version, with the option to add to existing comments or replace them. Use the Delete action to remove data point comments, dimension comments, or all comments from a selected version.
590040794.title: Comment Management Step

590040795.text:
A parameter used in a data action can't have more than 1,000 members. If you've been using a parameter with a member count that exceeds this limit, you'll get a warning message when running a data action that was added via story scripting. You'll be able to continue but we encourage you to use the data filter parameter instead of a member parameter.
If you haven't used a parameter with a member count of over 1,000 at all, you'll get an error message when running a data action. You won't be able to continue until you correct the parameter. We recommend using the data filter parameter instead of a member parameter.
590040795.title: Member Limit for Parameters in Data Action

590040796.text: For multi actions, the Job Monitor now lists no more than 20 members of a parameter. If you want to view a list of all members, please select Security and then, Activities. In the Activity column, select the job. Then, the Current Value column lists the full number of members.
590040796.title: Member Limit in Job Monitor for Multi Actions

590040797.text: The background process for copying and pasting underlying values in tables has been redesigned to offer better performance. This change makes copy/paste operations faster, and improves overall productivity and scalability for larger models.
590040797.title: Improved Copy/Paste Performance in Tables

590040798.text: The entity selection interface has been improved in predictive planning, enabling dynamic selection modes with hierarchical menu support. Users can now select multiple entries efficiently, exclude specific members and navigate hierarchy leaves without having to manually select leaf members one-by-one. Overall, this improvement streamlines predictive planning workflows and reduces configuration time.
590040798.title: Enhanced Entity Selector with Dynamic Selection

590040799.text: You can now multiply copied plan data by a factor directly in the copy step, eliminating the need for a separate script step. For example, you can enter 1.05 to copy the plan data, increasing it by 5%. Alternatively, you can enter a number parameter as copy factor.
590040799.title: Factor in Copy Step

590040800.text: A new onBeforeDataEntryProcess() table event now allows planners to check data changes before they are processed by the application. The data changes include data input via single, mass or fluid data entry, copy and paste operations or value distribution.
590040800.title: New <samp class="ph codeph">onBeforeDataEntryProcess()</samp> Table Event

590040801.text:
You can now check the state of multiple cells with the getStates API.
You can now set the states of multiple cell with the setStates API.Note
As a prerequisite, your SAP Analytics Cloud planning models are enabled for data locking and you're using the optimized story experience.
590040801.title: Check or set the states of Multiple Cells

590040802.text:
The onAfterExecute event for data uploads now includes additional information. In addition to the status of the data upload, the event includes:
- a message about the result of the upload operation.
- statistics about the upload (for example, rows processed).
- a list of the rejected records
- the name of the target version.
- the file name that was uploaded.
590040802.title: <samp class="ph codeph">OnAfterExecute</samp> event includes more information

590040803.text: Previously, deleting volumes of data audit logs larger than 50 million records could generate a timeout error, and administrators had to delete multiple small batches of data audit logs as a workaround.The process to delete data audit logs has been refined, and the size limit has been increased. Administrators can now delete large volumes of data audit logs in one go. This enhancement saves time for administrators and allows them to manage data audit logs more efficiently.
590040803.title: Deleting Audit Data Logs

590040804.text: You'll no longer get notifications regarding validation rules because of master data and hierarchy structure updates. You'll still get notifications if updates can lead to disruptive changes, such as validation rules being out of sync, deactivated, restructured, or deleted.
590040804.title: Validation Rule Notifications

590040805.text: We've added the HTTP response 204 to the list of expected results of a multi-action API step. This HTTP response indicates that a request has been successfully processed by the server but there's no content to send back in the response body. This status is used when no additional information needs be provided by the server.
590040805.title: Allowed HTTP Responses in the Multi-Action API step.

590040806.text: We've enhanced the restrictions on HTTP header fields for Multi Action API steps. .
590040806.title: Enhanced Restrictions of Customized Headers for Multi Action API steps

590040807.text: When configuring data locking, you can now add up to six driving dimensions. (The previous limit was four.)
590040807.title: Driving Dimension Limit

590040808.text: In the Job Monitor, the External Function entry in the Started From column is being deprecated. Instead, whenever possible, the Job Monitor now provides details regarding the Microsoft Excel workbook with which a data action was started. If the Excel workbook has been saved to the SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) repository, the entry consists of the Microsoft Excel logo icon and the file name displayed as a link, for example, FinancialPlan2026.xls. If the file is a local file, the file name is displayed as plain text. If the file hasn't been saved yet, the entry says Unsaved Add-in Workbook. Note: Job Monitor entries saved before this deprecation continue to display "External Function" until the system captures a new snapshot of the data after the retention period.
590040808.title: Add-in Workbook Details in Job Monitor

590040809.text: For data actions, the Job Monitor now lists no more than 20 members of a parameter. If you want to view a list of all members, please select Security and then, Activities. In the Activity column, select the job. Then, the Current Value column lists the full number of members.
590040809.title: Member Limit in Job Monitor

590040810.text: Setting target values to zero for dates with no associated data now enhances prediction accuracy for intermittent and discontinued entities. This feature addresses the issue of missing dates in time series, leading to more reliable modeling results without requiring complex data actions from users.
590040810.title: Improved Prediction Accuracy with Zero Value Setting

590040811.text: When you select Get API trigger status from HTTP status code and response body as Response option during API step creation, mapping the status field of the external application to the Status Field in API step is no longer mandatory. The Status information is now retrieved from the HTTP status code by default.
590040811.title: Creating an HTTP API Connection

590040812.text: You can now run data actions in synchronous mode. This option is recommended for short-running data actions. A data action in synchronous mode runs immediately and bypasses the workload queue. This options lets you start multiple data actions on different versions.
590040812.title: Synchronous Mode for Data Actions

590040813.text: You can now use AI to help create Data Action documentation. Select Generate Documentation above the Documentation field. If needed, you can provide user hints to the AI to have it rewrite the documentation.
590040813.title: AI-assisted Data Action Documentation

590040814.text: You can now link models that use different granularities for the planning time dimension; for example, day and month.
590040814.title: Linking models that use different granularities for the planning time dimension

590040815.text: If you publish a large version, publication is run as a background job. You can now view information for these asynchronous version publish jobs in the job monitor. The detail panel shows information such as the Source Version and Target Version. If a job fails, the job monitor also provides up to 5 records that caused the failure, along with other related information. Invalid facts are visible to only the user who executed the version publish job, and only the user who triggered the version publish job has permission to cancel it. Users with the appropriate privileges can also cancel jobs that haven't been completed.
590040815.title: Version Publish Job in Job Monitor

590040816.text:
Instead of having to run a script to delete facts in data actions, you can now add a Fact Deletion step. This method is much faster than using a script.
Under Options, you can choose among three delete modes:
Delete Facts: Deletes facts specified with the filters.
Delete Zeros from Facts: Deletes only the facts you've filtered that have value 0.
Set Facts to Zero: Sets the filtered facts to the value 0.
590040816.title: Fact Deletion Step

590040817.text:
You can now work with large processes in the calendar without risking browser slowdowns or crashes. The system now limits the number of events in the following areas:
- In the list workspace, results are capped at 35,000 events, with guidance to filter further.
- In the Gantt chart, a placeholder appears when your visible expanded events exceed 1,000.
- In the calendar wizard, you cannot generate more than 35,000 events at once.
590040817.title: Performance Guardrails for Calendar Events

590040818.text:
You can now use the following APIs to update calendar events:
- getAssignees
- getViewers
- addViewer
- removeViewer
The hasUserRole API now accepts the viewer role: CalendarTaskUserRoleType.Viewer
590040818.title: APIs for Calendar Event Updates and Viewer Role

590040819.text: You can now use keyboard shortcuts for the following actions: submit, decline, approve, reject, and agree.
590040819.title: New Keyboard Shortcuts

590040820.text:
Previously, the system automatically resolved teams when you activated a calendar event. Now, the system keeps team references by default unless you resolve the teams. If you or someone else adds or removes users from a team, the system displays a warning in the Details panel of the event. As owner, you can then synchronize individual teams or all teams that are involved in the event. You can also synchronize the teams involved for multiple events in the Edit Events wizard.When you activate a process, reopen an event, or update it, all involved teams that have updates are synchronized automatically. When you are the owner and assignee of a review task and you reject the work, the system automatically synchronizes all involved teams.
Note
For composite tasks, the system still resolves involved teams when you activate the tasks.
590040820.title: Team References Retained Upon Event Activation

590040821.text:
In compass simulations, random sampling is now supported for drivers that have a zero or unbooked baseline.
This enhancement allows planners to account for uncertainty and simulate model accounts with no historical activity or interrupted by strategic changes.
590040821.title: Random Sampling Support for 0 or Unbooked Baseline

590040822.text: Simulation owners and users with appropriate delete permission can now delete all private scenarios from a compass simulation. A notification will be sent out to all affected users after a simulation has been deleted.This enhancement helps simulation creators clean up outdated scenarios, and reduces tenant maintenance overhead for administrators.
590040822.title: Delete Private Scenarios

590040823.text: A new compass widget is now available, offering better integration between compass and stories. Until now, viewing table and chart values and the corresponding risks required you to go back and forth between stories and the compass module. With the introduction of the compass widget, you can now add risk simulation results directly into stories.
590040823.title: Introducing the Compass Widget

590040824.text: Compass now allows you to define realistic driver ranges using predictive time series forecasts. The integration of predictive capabilities will help you generate data-driven driver ranges for compass simulations based on historical insights.
590040824.title: Define Data-Driver Driver Ranges with Predictive Integration

590040825.text: In compass, you can now create simulations and run scenarios from tables in stories that have complex filters such as time range, attribute, exclude or advanced filters. Filters from the table are transferred to compass, refining the integration between stories and compass.
590040825.title: Create Simulations from Tables with Complex Filters

590040826.text: In compass, you can now use accounts and measures set with AVG incl. Unbooked and AVG excl. NULL exception aggregation types as drivers.
590040826.title: Support for AVG incl. Unbooked and AVG excl. NULL Exception Aggregation Types

590040827.text:
You can now run a private scenario even when multiple hierarchies for a specific dimension are used across filters in compass.
For example, you create a simulation from a table data cell and two filters using different hierarchies on a dimension are then present in both input filters and output filters in compass. Previously, this setup caused a validation error due to the presence of multiple hierarchies. With the enhancement, you can successfully run a private scenario without needing to address this issue.
590040827.title: Support for Multiple Hierarchies

590040828.text: Compass now supports seamless planning. This means you can create simulations based on models whose data is stored in SAP Datasphere.
590040828.title: Seamless Planning Support

590040829.text:
In compass, when you add restricted drivers from a base driver and set their value configurations, overlapping filters for these restricted drivers now lead to a validation error. For example, suppose you configure value configurations on one restricted driver with filters set to "Germany, Shoes" and another with filters set to "Europe, Shoes". In this case, you will encounter a validation error because "Germany" is a child member of "Europe", creating overlapping filters.
This error alerts you to the overlapping filters and the conflicting value configurations. You need to fix it before running the scenario.
590040829.title: Validation Errors for Conflicting Value Configurations

590040830.text: In compass, when setting value ranges for drivers in private scenarios, you can now enter relative values that represent calculations applied to the baseline values. For example, you can enter "+10" to represent a value that increases the baseline by 10.
590040830.title: Entering Relative Values for Driver Value Configurations

590040831.text: When you create a compass simulation from a data cell in a story table, you can now choose to create it either in the current browser tab or in a new one. Creating a simulation in a new browser tab allows you to conveniently navigate between the story and simulation.
590040831.title: Creating Simulations in New Browser Tab

590040832.text:
In compass, a driver that doesn't support value configuration, meaning random sampling can't or won't be done on such a driver, now comes with one of the following labels shown in the Value Configuration column:
- Deactivated
- Restricted Drivers Attached
- Unsupported Aggregation Configuration
- 0 or Unbooked Baseline
- Mixed Currencies or Units
To focus on drivers that support value configuration, you can remove those that do not by going to  (Select Drivers)  Remove Drivers Not Supporting Value Configuration.
590040832.title: New Driver Labels

590040833.text:
You can now use SAP Analytics Cloud compass, a new app that allows you estimate the possible outcomes of uncertain business events using Monte Carlo simulation. By gaining insights into the range of potential outcomes and the probabilities of achieving them, it empowers you to make more informed business decisions in the face of uncertainty. Best of all, you can achieve this without the need for prior IT setup or advanced statistical skills.
In compass, you can do the following:
- Create simulations with scenario modelling capabilities: To address your business question, create a simulation from a table data cell or the compass start page. Within the simulation, you can create scenarios to simulate the impact of driver assumptions on the target values. The simulation can be saved as a file repository artifact and shared with others.
- Configure drivers in private scenarios: In a private scenario, select from available drivers and configure drivers by setting their input filters and randomness. In particular, you can set value ranges and probability distribution types to specify driver randomness.
- Add and configure restricted drivers: Add restricted drivers from a base driver by configuring their specific filters, and set value ranges and probability distribution types to specify randomness on restricted drivers.
- Run private scenarios: Run private scenarios in different precision modes and get simulation results visualized by a graph for each run.
- Analyze simulation results: Based on the simulation result graph, analyze the probability distribution of the simulated outcomes. You can also move the slider to explore chances of achieving below or above a specific target value. Additional operations, such as defining case settings and adding comparison scenarios, provide further insights into the simulation results.
- Create public scenarios: Publish private scenarios to create public scenarios, making them available to all users with access to the simulation.
[See feature on the roadmap](https://roadmaps.sap.com/board?PRODUCT=67838200100800006884&range=2025Q1-2025Q1#;INNO=CDB9DE7F0A221EDEB2ED3B8CBA55E56D).
590040833.title: Introducing SAP Analytics Cloud Compass

590040834.text: The URL API operators and range intervals for variables are now supported in the mobile app.
590040834.title: URL API Operators and Range Intervals

590040835.text: Scripting is now supported for the AI-Assisted Prompt Insights widget. Story designers will now be able to leverage and consume AI-generated insights across widgets in their stories. This enhancement will help facilitate and speed up decision-making, while maximizing returns on embedded intelligence.
590040835.title: Scripting Support for AI-Assisted Prompt Insights

590040836.text: Multilingual support for just ask model readiness checks are now available in French, Italian, Spanish, and German. Just ask administrators managing models with non-English metadata now receive improved quality analysis and recommendations for multilingual models, eliminating missed or incorrectly flagged temporal keywords, dimensions, and measures.
590040836.title: Multilingual Support for Just Ask Model Readiness Checks

590040837.text: Just Ask administrators can now run a model readiness check to assess how well-optimized a model is for natural language interactions in Just Ask and Joule analytical insights. The check is available on the new Readiness Check tab on the Manage Model page. After the check runs, a readiness report lists detected issues by priority, identifies the affected objects, and recommends actions to improve model quality. Administrators can act directly on the findings by hiding objects from the Just Ask search or by adding synonyms to measures, dimensions, and dimension members to provide clearer, more business-friendly names for querying.
590040837.title: Model Readiness Check for Just Ask and Joule Analytical Insights

590040838.text: Story designers can now add an AI-Assisted Prompt Insights widget to their story to generate intelligent, data-backed business insights from table data. Enter a natural prompt, and let the application come up with AI generated insights based on your planning data.The AI Prompt Insights widget combines planning data analysis with real-time web search capabilities using a large language model.
590040838.title: Introducing AI-Assisted Prompt Insights

590040839.text: Smart Insights are now available for accounts dimensions that have multiple hierarchies. Insights are generated based on the account hierarchy used in the widget.
590040839.title: Smart Insights Support for Account Dimensions with Multiple Hierarchies

590040840.text: Just ask now understands fiscal and calendar time expressions, so you can query using fiscal periods, fiscal years, and week granularity in natural language. Queries like "sales by fiscal period," "cost of goods sold for P01 2025," or "sales by week for Q2" return results from the correct time hierarchy automatically.
590040840.title: Fiscal and Calendar Time Support in Just Ask

590040841.text: Just ask now supports dynamic time filters, so you can use natural language expressions like "last year," "YTD," or "previous 3 quarters" to query your data. The resulting charts automatically reflect the requested period as time progresses. You can look back or ahead relative to a pivot date, include data up to today's current date.
590040841.title: Dynamic Time Filter Support in Just Ask

590040842.text:
Just ask now generates a human-readable explanation alongside each chart, showing you how your natural language question was interpreted. For example, asking "show me sales by state year to date" surfaces which measures, dimensions, filters, and variables were recognized so you can quickly verify the result matches your intent and refine your question if needed.
Expand the Explanation section to view details. A concise chart title and a summary of how your question was processed is also generated as part of the chart.
590040842.title: AI-Generated Explanations for Just Ask Results

590040843.text: When asking questions in the just ask feature using SAP Datasphere models, dimension members are now suggested as you type. For example, typing revenue by region surfaces available region members inline, helping you build precise queries without needing to know exact member names in advance.
590040843.title: Dimension Member Suggestions in Just Ask for SAP Datasphere Models

590040844.text:
You can now inspect the included and excluded members of a complex date filter directly within the charts returned by the just ask feature — no need to copy a chart into a story first.
When the complex filter is expanded, members are shown as a bulleted list organized into Include and Exclude sections.
590040844.title: View Complex Filter Members in Just Ask

590040845.text:
For SAP Datasphere and Seamless Planning models, progressive loading of Top Contributors is now enabled automatically when the number of dimensions or hierarchy levels exceeds 20. No configuration is required.
Top Contributors are not supported for non-additive measures (for example, ratios or exception aggregations).
590040845.title: Automatic Loading Smart Insights Top Contributors

590040846.text: You can now mix excluded date members with date range filters in Just Ask. For example: "Show me taxes by product for 2013–2017 excluding Q3 2015". Previously this produced a warning and removed the excluded date; now the exclusion is preserved by applying an Advanced Filter. After copying the resulting chart into a Story, the Advanced Filter can be viewed and edited.
590040846.title: Mixing Advanced Filters in Just Ask

590040847.text: A new shortcut button has been added to the just ask model details page in Manage Models, allowing you to quickly go edit the model directly from the just ask interface. The model opens in its respective modeling tool: the SAP Analytics Cloud modeler or SAP Datasphere Data Builder, depending on the model type.
590040847.title: Shortcut Button from Just Ask Manage Models to Model Editor

590040848.text:
For SAP applications that use Joule's analytical insights capability, there is now automatic synchronization and re-import of teams, roles, and permissions. If the following types of changes are made to teams, roles and permissions in SAP Analytics Cloud after the initial import into SAP Build Work Zone, they will now be automatically re-imported and re-synced with SAP Build Work Zone:
-
- The Read or Execute permission for the Joule privilege is added, updated or removed on a role.
- A role with the Joule privilege is added, updated, or removed from a team.
- A new team is created or existing team deleted that has a role with the Joule privilege.
590040848.title: Analytical Insights Capability - Automatic synchronization and re-import of teams, roles, and permissions from SAP Analytics Cloud to SAP Build Work Zone

590040849.text: Dimension members are now included in SAP Datasphere model suggestions — users can view and select them directly.
590040849.title: Dimension members in SAP Datasphere Models

590040850.text: Smart Insights are now available in Lite Viewer.
590040850.title: Lite Viewer Support

590040851.text:
You can now enter Compound Growth Rate (CGR) queries to visualize growth over time in charts. Supported queries include:
- Show me the compound growth rate of sales from 2024 to 2025
- What is the CAGR of sales between 2024 and 2025
- Quarterly CGR of expenses from Q1 to Q2
590040851.title: Just Ask Search Multiple Filters on Date/Time Dimension

590040852.text:
You can now query the percentage contribution of dimension members to the overall total. Examples include:
- How much does California contribute to total USA sales?
- What percentage of total sales comes from Food and Drink?
590040852.title: Just Ask User Interface Improvements

590040853.text: Just Ask admins can now define a default time dimension and time period for each measure. For example, when a user asks Sales by region and the default time period is set to 2025, the result automatically applies a 2025 time filter—no additional input required.
590040853.title: Time Dimension and Time Period Defaults

590040854.text: The new member selector is now available in Smart Predict. This addition enhances usability by allowing users to display members using id, description, or both, making it easier to select members efficiently. Additionally, this integration aligns with existing SAP Analytics Cloud workflows, providing a consistent user experience across predictive planning.
590040854.title: Unified Member Selector for Smart Predict
