590040855.text: Planning users with Edit access (Update permission) for intelligent content can update currency rate tables to maintain their own currency conversion rates within intelligent content folders. This includes importing rates from source systems and creating version-specific rates. The lifecycle of the intelligent content remains SAP-managed and the intelligent content continues to function without compromising content governance.
590040855.title: Editing of Intelligent Content Enabled for Currency Rate Tables

590040856.text: Planning users with Edit access (Maintain permission) for intelligent content can edit models and dimensions to support planning workflows. They can adjust planning data in tables, manage versions of planning data, and make other adjustments related to planning workflows, including forecasting and automation. The lifecycle of the intelligent content remains SAP-managed and the intelligent content continues to function without compromising content governance.
590040856.title: Editing of Intelligent Content Enabled for Planning Workflows Only

590040857.text:
Search in the Files section of the New Export wizard is now faster and more focused.
A new root-node filter lets you scope your search to a single location - such as Public, Sample, System, Users, or Workspace instead of scanning the entire content repository. The default filter is set to Public, which covers the most common export scenarios. Search results are now displayed as a flat list with path information, replacing the previous tree structure, so results load faster.
590040857.title: Optimized Search Performance in New Export Wizard

590040858.text:
Administrators have more flexibility when sharing and copying files and folders in the Intelligent Content view of the Files repository.
- Administrators can share folders or individual files with users or teams. By default, View access (Read and Copy permissions) is given. If needed, you can grant custom access with Read permission only.
- When sharing intelligent content, the App Files folder and its contents are automatically shared to ensure dependencies remain intact.
- Users with the Copy permission can copy folders or individual files to a location of their choice.
590040858.title: Improved Share and Copy Capabilities for Intelligent Content

590040859.text:
A user can run the api/v1/filerepository/transfer/Resources API to move a single resource or a list of resources, such as stories, models, or analytic applications, from their current location to a destination folder. This API will return an operation ID.
The user will then be able to use the operation ID when they run the api/v1/filerepository/operations/{operationId} API to check the status of the resource transfer.
590040859.title: API Moves Resources from One Location to Another

590040860.text: As a data analyzer user you can now drag one dimension and drop it onto a data cell. This simplifies the interaction on the table by enabling you to swap dimensions and filter on the dimension member and measure in one step.
590040860.title: Dragging and Dropping a Dimension on a Data Cell

590040861.text: As a data analyzer user who wants to export data as Microsoft Excel file, you can now use the Enable appendix option in the Export Data as Microsoft Excel File dialog, which allows you to control whether additional query information is included in Microsoft Excel exports. This feature simplifies the export process and provides flexibility in customizing export output to meet specific data requirements.
590040861.title: Using Appendix Toggle Option in Microsoft Excel Export Dialog

590040862.text:
As a data analyzer user, you can now access models more efficiently through clickable model names in the Information panel. The model name in the Information panel's model section now appears as a clickable link for:
- SAP Analytics Cloud models
- SAP Datasphere models
By clicking the model name link for SAP Analytics Cloud models, you are directed to the model in the SAP Analytics Cloud modeler. By clicking it for SAP Datasphere models, the model is opened in the data builder.
590040862.title: Using Clickable Model Name Links in Information Panel

590040863.text: As a user of data analyzer, you can now add one or multiple hyperlinks of type External URL to the data analyzer table. For this, you open the Create Hyperlink dialog from the Styling panel. You can select one dimension per hyperlink via the content assistance to easily insert the dimension into the URL. The hyperlink is shown on the dimension members on the table. When you click the hyperlink, the destination URL opens in a new browser tab. You can edit and delete the hyperlink. All hyperlinks are listed by name in the Styling panel.
590040863.title: Adding Hyperlinks of Type External URL to the Data Analyzer Table

590040864.text: For configuring the variable prompt settings for an insight, you can now use the variable prompt submenu within the data analyzer toolbar. The settings Automatically open prompt when insight opens and Keep last saved values for dynamic variableswithin the Save Insight dialog moved to this new sub menu. As a new configuration option, you can clear all variables for saved insights. This way, you do not have to pre-select mandatory variable prompts.
590040864.title: Using the Variable Prompt Submenu in the Toolbar

590040865.text:
In data analyzer, you can now switch the display options of measures on the table by using the menu button of the measure structure in the Builder panel. The following display options are available:
- ID
- Description
- ID and Description
- Description and ID
590040865.title: Using New Option to Display Measure ID on Table Result Set

590040866.text: In the Create/Edit Calculation dialog, you can now use and display not only the ID for a measure or dimension but also the description by clicking the Show Description button above the Formula editing area.
590040866.title: Showing Descriptions for Measures and Dimensions in Calculation Editor

590040867.text:
When opening data analyzer from a story with dynamic filters, the dynamic filters are now also available in data analyzer instead of becoming fixed filters. The following dynamic filter types are brought over to data analyzer:
- story dynamic filters created on story, page or widget level for time dimensions and SAP BW fiscal-based dimensions
- story dynamic filters created in restricted dimensions
- story dynamic filters created in structures (cross calculations)
590040867.title: Support of Story Dynamic Filters in Data Analyzer

590040868.text: As a data analyzer user you can now create a dynamic filter for fiscal time dimensions based on the individual fiscal variants defined in the underlying SAP BW query.
590040868.title: Creating Dynamic Filters for Fiscal Time Dimensions

590040869.text: As a user of the data analyzer calculation editor you can now use date dimensions within functions so that you can perform more precise and meaningful data analyses.
590040869.title: Using Date Dimensions in Calculation Editor Functions

590040870.text: In the Styling panel in data analyzer you can now use region-specific scaling options for number formatting
590040870.title: Using Region-Specific Scaling Options for Number Formatting

590040871.text:
Starting in data analyzer, you can now open your data for further analysis in SAP Analytics Cloud, add-in for Microsoft Excel. For this, select Open in Microsoft Add-In in the data analyzer Export menu. This will download an SAP Analytics Cloud, add-in for Microsoft Excel workbook with the current state of your analysis in data analyzer. The SAP Analytics Cloud, add-in for Microsoft Excel can be opened with the data displayed in the same navigation state as in data analyzer once you login to SAP Analytics Cloud from the workbook.
For remote connections, like SAP BW or SAP HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, add-in for Microsoft Excel only supports tunnel connections.
590040871.title: Jump from Data Analyzer to SAP Analytics Cloud, add-in for Microsoft Excel for Further Data Analysis

590040872.text:
You can now schedule a data analyzer insight based on a SAP Datasphere live connection.
For this the following prerequisites must be met:
- Create an SAP Datasphere tunnel connection in SAP Analytics Cloud
- Schedule insight based on the SAP Datasphere tunnel connection (direct connection will not work)
590040872.title: Scheduling of Data Analyzer Insights Based on SAP Datasphere Live Connection

590040873.text: In the variable dialog, once a variable value field is in focus for the user to edit, the member value displayed will change to display the ID of the member. The user can then edit and must enter a member ID. Once the input field loses focus, the displayed text corresponds to what is selected in the Values Display settings. For example, if ID and Description is selected, the ID and Description will be displayed after the field loses focus.
590040873.title: Search by ID in Variable Dialog

590040874.text: For ad-hoc analyses based on remote models or SAP BW models, you can now use the new property Show Number Values for mixed units / currencies in the styling panel of the data analyzer table. This property allows you to display the values of measures that have mixed units and currencies in addition to the asterisk.
590040874.title: Showing Values for Measures with Mixed Units and Currencies

590040875.text: When creating formulas in data analyzer, you can now use the function COUNTDIMENSIONS.
590040875.title: New Function in Calculation Editor

590040876.text: The information dialog in the Additional Options menu has been replaced by a new Information panel next to the Builder and Styling panel in the side navigation bar. This panel delivers the comprehensive details you need to identify the underlying components—from data sources to static filters—that shape your insights. The panel dynamically adjusts its content based on the underlying model type (SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP BW, SAP HANA, SAP Datasphere), ensuring you only see relevant information. It uses distinct, dedicated sections to display details on the models, connections, queries, variables, dates, and global filters giving you a clear view of your insights' foundations.
590040876.title: Using the New Information Panel

590040877.text:
As a data analyzer user, you can now customize the visual design of your chart's legend and labels through the new chart properties section in the Styling panel. The following options are available for charts:
- show/hide legend
- change the position of the legend
- change the alignment of the legend
- show/hide axis title
- show/hide axis label
- change axis label direction
590040877.title: Using the New Chart Properties Section in the Styling Panel

590040878.text:
You can now use the following new functions in the Add Calculation or Edit Calculation dialog in data analyzer:
- TOTEXT (not available for the SAP BW model type)
- LOWERCASE (not available for the SAP BW model type)
- UPPERCASE (not available for the SAP BW model type)
- ACCOUNTLOOKUP (only for the standard model type)
- MEASURELOOKUP (only for the standard model type)
- RESTRICT
The AI-Assisted Calculation service has been improved/updated to support all the functions listed above.
590040878.title: Using New Functions in the Calculation Editor

590040879.text: Administrators can now assign additional Content Security Policy (CSP) directives when configuring trusted domains in SAP Analytics Cloud. Alongside the existing script-src option, you can now restrict which external domains are permitted to load images (img-src), stylesheets (style-src), fonts (font-src), and specific JavaScript-based APIs for initiating network connections (connect-src). This gives you finer-grained control over browser resource loading and strengthens protection against cross-site scripting and data injection attacks.
590040879.title: Additional Content Security Policy (CSP) Directives for Trusted Domains

590040880.text: The Data Storage for Planning setting has been deprecated from the  System  Administration  Tenant Links tab. You can create a formation in BTP cockpit or SAP for Me to integrate SAP Analytics Cloud with SAP Datasphere. The unified customer landscape formations enable the automated integration between a set of your provisioned SAP systems.
590040880.title: Deprecation of the Data Storage for Planning setting

590040881.text:
Administrators with access to the roles page can now manage the permissions of the story privilege. The story permissions are no longer automatically assigned to users via the global role.
For a custom role, you can grant or remove the create, read, update, delete, or share permissions of the story privilege.
In addition, you're able to see what story permissions are enabled for the standard application roles.
590040881.title: Exposed Story Privilege in the Roles Permissions Detail Page

590040882.text: You now have the option to lock the Resources card to the top-left corner of the home screen. Users can't hide or move a locked card.
590040882.title: Lock Option Within the Resources Card

590040883.text: The legacy monitoring tool (System  Monitor from the side navigation menu) is no longer available. Use the System Overview page (System  Overview from the side navigation menu), introduced in the Q2 2023 release, for detailed system usage analysis and monitoring capabilities. Access real-time license consumption rates, fast security reviews, user activities, performance statistics, and other housekeeping information.
590040883.title: Legacy System Monitor No Longer Available

590040884.text: Create a Custom home screen card. The administrator can fully customize the content in the rich text editor, upload an image, choose a tag type, and lock the card on the home screen for all users.
590040884.title: Custom Home Card

590040885.text: Monitor and analyze your system usage with the System Monitor home screen card. This card is only available for administrative roles to get an overview about their system, such as license usage, content overview, and legacy content usage information.
590040885.title: System Monitor Home Card

590040886.text: Stay informed of critical updates and alerts that require your attention with the Administrative Actions home screen card. This card is only available for administrative roles to quickly identify and resolve performance impacting queries.
590040886.title: Administrative Actions Home Card
